derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in picture-frame.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Stile, left
boxes.derivation: Drawn upright on the west side: 1 1/2" across X, 13" up Y (the outer height, 10 + 2 x 1 1/2), 3/4" thick. Its inside edge is its east edge, x = 1 1/2. Occupies x 0..1 1/2, y 0..13, z 0..3/4.

boxes.name: Stile, right
boxes.derivation: The left stile's twin, turned half a turn (180 degrees = 648000") about its anchor at (11, 13) so that its local east (inside) edge faces west: local x 0..1 1/2 maps to 11 - 1 1/2 .. 11 = 9 1/2..11 and local y 0..13 to 13 - 13 .. 13 = 0..13. Occupies x 9 1/2..11, y 0..13, z 0..3/4.

boxes.name: Rail, bottom
boxes.derivation: Drawn along X at the bottom: 11" (the outer width, 8 + 2 x 1 1/2) across X, 1 1/2" up Y, 3/4" thick. Its inside edge is its north edge, y = 1 1/2. Occupies x 0..11, y 0..1 1/2, z 0..3/4.

boxes.name: Rail, top
boxes.derivation: The bottom rail's twin, turned half a turn about its anchor at (11, 13) so that its local north (inside) edge faces south: local x 0..11 maps to 0..11 and local y 0..1 1/2 to 13 - 1 1/2 .. 13 = 11 1/2..13. Occupies x 0..11, y 11 1/2..13, z 0..3/4.

cutList.label: Stile
cuts: Mitre the south end: from 1 1/2" in along the east edge to the south-west corner (45° off square).
Mitre the north end: from 1 1/2" in along the east edge to the north-west corner (45° off square).
cutList.derivation: Plan axes x = width, y = length: width 1 1/2" = 1536, length 13" = 13312, thickness (the depth) 3/4" = 768. The length is the blank, which is the long point: the mitres run from the inside edge to the outside corners, so the outside edge keeps the whole 13" and the inside edge is 13 - 2 x 1 1/2 = 10", the opening's height. Both boxes carry the same cuts in their own frames (south-east and north-east, 1 1/2" x 1 1/2"), so they are one row of 2 (§4.3); one is simply turned. Sentences (§4.4, cuts in site order south-east then north-east): at the south-east corner the setback along X, 1 1/2", is the whole south end, so it is a mitre of the south end from a mark 1 1/2" along the east edge to the far corner of the south end, south-west; equal setbacks are exactly 45 degrees. North-east likewise: the north end, to the north-west corner. Text: 13 = 1 x 12 + 1 -> 1'-1". Label: "Stile, left" and "Stile, right" share "Stile, " -> "Stile".

cutList.label: Rail
cuts: Mitre the east end: from 1 1/2" in along the north edge to the south-east corner (45° off square).
Mitre the west end: from 1 1/2" in along the north edge to the south-west corner (45° off square).
cutList.derivation: Plan axes x = length, y = width: length 11" = 11264, width 1 1/2" = 1536, thickness 3/4" = 768. Long point 11"; the inside edge is 11 - 2 x 1 1/2 = 8", the opening's width. Same cuts on both (north-west and north-east), so one row of 2. Sentences, in site order north-east then north-west: at the north-east corner the setback along Y, 1 1/2", is the whole east end, so: mitre the east end from a mark 1 1/2" along the north edge to the far corner of the east end, south-east; at the north-west corner, the west end, to the south-west corner. Both exactly 45 degrees. Sorted after the stiles because 11" < 13". Label: "Rail, bottom" and "Rail, top" share "Rail, " -> "Rail".
